summary: This bill amends the Federal Fire Prevention and Control Act of 1974 to require the Administrator of the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) to reimburse fire departments for expenses incurred when National Fire Academy courses or activities are canceled due to a lapse in FEMA appropriations.

scores.thoughts: This bill mandates reimbursement for fire departments for expenses incurred due to the cancellation of National Fire Academy courses during a government shutdown. This creates a new obligation for federal spending, increasing it, albeit for specific circumstances.

The bill creates a new mandatory federal reimbursement obligation for travel and backfill expenses incurred by fire departments when National Fire Academy courses are cancelled due to appropriations lapses. This requires additional outlays without any revenue offset or spending reduction, producing a minor increase in the deficit to support this narrow priority.
